title: 第3691章 全部出击到了第3690章 算计千万别死了
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
伊莱亚斯没有料到，卡洛斯竟然会带着那七名投了赞同票的巅峰主宰私自行动。
就算他们没有参与这件事情，也会因为这件事情被卷进去。
空如今还没有突破宇宙至尊，拿什么去直面苍鬼？
而原本投反对票的那些巅峰主宰们，得知这个情况后，有些人还在犹豫，但有些人却是立刻行动起来。
他们虽然不赞同卡洛斯等人的做法，但绝不会眼睁睁看着卡洛斯几人单独去扛事。
人族的巅峰主宰一共就只有那么多，若是因为不团结而导致巅峰主宰的陨落，对整个人族而言，都是难以接受的巨大损失。
而那些还在犹豫不决的巅峰主宰，见到有人行动，自然也坐不住了。
很不想趟这趟浑水的伊莱亚斯，也只能黑着脸一同出发。
本以为只要投票否决，就可以不插手这件事情。
可事到如今，他若是不参与进去，必然会被其他一众巅峰主宰鄙视。
届时，他在一众巅峰主宰中的形象，必然会跌到谷底。
以后再有巅峰主宰会议，他的话语权也会大大降低。
哪怕不愿意参与这件事情，他也只能被裹挟着被动参与进去。
“可恶！卡洛斯这个混蛋，是想把整个人族都拖入深渊吗？”
一边骂着，伊莱亚斯一边动身前往白虎圣地的通道出口。
人族所有巅峰主宰齐刷刷出动，此番目的就只有一个，那就是想尽一切办法保住叶凌。
至于白娅和白虎令，他们自然也想保，但以人族目前的力量，还无法和鬼族正面抗衡。
卡洛斯此番的目的，也只是想要保下叶凌这个未来有可能比肩空的人族天骄。
…………
白虎圣地通道内。

叶凌一行人此刻已然接近通道出口。
凝视着前方，白娅的眼神变得颇为凝重。
“前面就是出口了。”
平静的目视前方，叶凌嘴角勾起一抹浅笑，手轻轻抚摸过白娅柔顺的毛发。
“通道外，欢迎我们的队伍应该已经到了，希望……他们的实力别太弱。”
从之前鬼族小队那里得到的信息可以知道，他们之所以会在圣地外围巡视，就是鬼族至尊苍鬼特意安排的。
如今鬼族小队被覆灭，苍鬼不可能不知情。
得知鬼族小队被消灭，苍鬼必然会第一时间安排鬼族堵在圣地的通道出口。
只是不知道苍鬼这个宇宙至尊会不会亲自来。
成为宇宙至尊后，叶凌可还没有见识过其他宇宙至尊的实力。
千万年之前，苍鬼就已经成就宇宙至尊，经过千万年时间的沉淀，苍鬼的实力必然会更强。
至于有没有突破到更高等级，暂未可知。
苍鬼算是一个不错的对手，叶凌倒是挺期待和对方的会面。
只希望这位成名已久的至尊，能够稍微带来一点乐趣，不至于太无聊。
幽梦看着眼前这个信心十足的身影，内心无比感慨。
她从没想过，进入白虎圣地竟然还有如此简单粗暴的方式。
直接干掉圣地外围巡视的小队，堂而皇之的从通道进入，完全不担心敌人会在出口进行围剿。
content_en:
Elias did not expect that Carlos would take the seven peak masters who voted in favor to act privately.
Even if they are not involved in this matter, they will be involved because of this matter.
Sora has not yet broken through to the Supreme Being of the Universe, so what can he do to face the Aoi directly?
Among the peak masters who originally voted against it, after learning about this situation, some were still hesitant, but some took action immediately.
Although they did not agree with the actions of Carlos and others, they would never watch Carlos and others take care of the problem alone.
There are only so many peak masters in the human race. If the peak master falls due to disunity, it will be an unacceptable and huge loss for the entire human race.
And those peak masters who were still hesitating naturally couldn't sit still when they saw someone taking action.
Elias, who really didn't want to take a trip into this muddy water, could only set off together with a dark face.
I thought that as long as I voted no, I would be able to stay out of this matter.
But now, if he doesn't participate, he will definitely be despised by other peak masters.
By then, his image among the top masters will inevitably fall to the bottom.
If a peak person dominates a meeting in the future, his right to speak will be greatly reduced.
Even if he is unwilling to participate in this matter, he can only be coerced into passively participating.
"Damn it! Carlos, this bastard, wants to drag the entire human race into the abyss?"
While cursing, Elias set off for the exit of the White Tiger Holy Land.
All the peak masters of the human race came out in unison, with only one purpose, and that was to do everything possible to keep Ye Ling.
As for Bai Ya and the White Tiger Order, they naturally want to protect them, but with the current strength of the human race, they are still unable to compete head-on with the ghost race.
Carlos's purpose this time was just to protect Ye Ling, a human genius who might be as good as Kong in the future.
…………
Inside the passage of White Tiger Holy Land.
Ye Ling and his party were already approaching the exit of the passage.
Staring forward, Bai Ya's eyes became quite solemn.
"The exit is ahead."
Looking calmly ahead, Ye Ling raised a slight smile on his lips and gently stroked Bai Ya's soft hair with his hand.
"Outside the passage, the team welcoming us should have arrived. I hope... their strength is not too weak."
From the information received from the ghost clan team before, we can know that the reason why they patrol the periphery of the holy land is specially arranged by the ghost clan supreme Cang Gui.
Now that the ghost team has been destroyed, it is impossible for Cang Gui not to know about it.
After learning that the ghost team had been eliminated, Cang Gui would immediately arrange for the ghosts to block the exit of the holy land.
I just don’t know if Cang Gui, the supreme being of the universe, will come in person.
After becoming the Supreme of the Universe, Ye Lingke has not seen the strength of other Supremes of the Universe.
Tens of millions of years ago, Cang Gui had already achieved the supreme status of the universe. After tens of millions of years of accumulation, Cang Gui's strength will inevitably become stronger.
As for whether it has broken through to a higher level, it is not yet known.
Cang Gui is a good opponent, and Ye Ling is looking forward to meeting him.
I just hope that this long-famous Supreme can bring a little fun and not be too boring.
Youmeng looked at the confident figure in front of her and felt extremely emotional.
She had never thought that there was such a simple and crude way to enter the White Tiger Holy Land.
Directly kill the team patrolling the outside of the Holy Land, and enter through the passage in a dignified manner, without worrying that the enemy will encircle and suppress them at the exit.
